title: Rotation-based prompt sampler and CI hysteresis for reducing partition flaps
author: Sofia Ramirez
description: Motivation: CI flakes from prompt-set partition boundaries have been causing intermittent regression alerts when a small stable cluster of prompts crosses a shard boundary in sampled checks. This PR introduces a rotation-based prompt sampler that cycles evaluation windows across semantic partitions and a CI hysteresis gate that requires sustained degradation before failing the pipeline. Goals: reduce noisy false positives, keep CI sensitive to real regressions, and provide per-partition stability metrics for debugging. What changed: added a rotation sampler that maintains a deterministic rotation schedule keyed by Linear ticket + run id; added a hysteresis gate that aggregates pass-rate history over N windows before escalating; integrated new partition_stability_score and rotation_seed telemetry into eval traces; added unit/integration tests and a small CLI to visualize rotation windows locally. Backward compatibility: sampler is behind the feature flag eval.rotation_sampler.enabled=false by default and the CI gate is opt-in for teams via .eval-config.yaml. Rollout: feature gated for canary projects for two weeks, then flip default after monitoring. Documentation: included operational doc and a troubleshooting section describing common partition-flap symptoms and recommended remediation steps. Implementation notes: rotation sampler partitions prompts using existing semantic-clustering index (unchanged) and builds windows by round-robin across partitions instead of pure random sampling; the hysteresis gate computes an exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) of pass-rate per-partition and only fails the CI if EWMA falls below the threshold for M consecutive rotation windows. The design intentionally trades rapid failure detection for stability when signal is noisy. Single-line checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] CI workflow updates, [x] docs, [x] feature flag, [x] monitoring metrics added. Related: addresses recurring alerts referenced in ENG-1972 and ties into PM-884 for improved PR reliability.

files_snippets:
src/ci/hooks/hysteresis_gate.py: def check_window(self, partition_scores):
        ewma = self._update_ewma(partition_scores)
        if ewma < self.threshold and self.fail_count >= self.hysteresis_windows:
            return False
        return True

issue_summary: Reduces CI noise by rotating prompt sampling across semantic partitions and requiring sustained regression signal before failing CI. Adds partition-level stability metrics for faster root cause analysis.
release_notes: Add rotation-based sampler and opt-in CI hysteresis gate to reduce flaky eval regressions; feature disabled by default behind eval.rotation_sampler.enabled flag; rollout plan described in ops doc.
notes: Monitoring: new metrics 'eval.partition_stability_score' and 'eval.rotation_window_index' emitted. Recommend enabling for one canary project and observing 14 days of alerts before defaulting on.
regression_risks: Low — feature gated and opt-in; hysteresis may delay detection of fast regressions, team should tune grace_windows threshold for critical paths.
